matches.rationale: GT-1 concerns the derivation in Section 3.1 where the tensor product operator is claimed to disappear via the Representer theorem without rigorous justification. None of the three findings address this specific methodological issue in Section 3.1; they all focus on different problems in Sections 3.3 and 3.5 (undefined M^H, missing factor of 2, sign inconsistency in HSIC).

pred_verdicts.rationale: Reports an undefined matrix M^H in Section 3.3's HSIC formulation, which is not in the ground truth.
Reports a missing factor of 2 in the graph-embedding identity in Eq. (6), which is not in the ground truth.
Reports a sign/maximization inconsistency for HSIC in Sections 3.3 and 3.5, which is not in the ground truth.
